question: I want to add someone to my account.
expected_outcome: CLARIFICATION / CODE LIMITATION — Request the member ID and intended relationship, then explain the verified joining process. For example, FAM001 already links M001 (Primary) and M003 (Spouse); do not add a member or claim a change was completed. If family_account intent is recognised without member ID, validation returns AMBIGUOUS; otherwise general. No family membership or miles transfer is performed.
